num_workers_2.note: The upstream collator seeds its block-size RNG from a counter it shares across workers; the increment order is not deterministic, so block sizes and the batch-wide min_keep truncation can differ. Sample order and augmented pixels still match exactly.

reproducibility_level: num_workers=0: sample order, augmented pixels and mask geometry are bit-reproducible across repeated runs; the image cache is pixel-equivalent to decoding the sources. Multi-worker loading is deliberately NOT used for the reported runs.
